hook: orphan 喜悅團開汽水：alacrity／euphoria／exultant／blithe——泡沫噴到天花板還說「再來一罐」。
script: alacrity 欣然。euphoria／ecstatic 狂喜。exultant 歡騰。blithe 無憂。gaiety 歡樂。delectation 愉悅。口令：汽水寫「開开心」，別把 blithe 寫成無知到危險還笑。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 開罐手: alacrity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「開罐手」出場：alacrity 一上場梗就黏住——欣然迅速。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of great (usually exaggerated) elation
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 泡沫頂: euphoria walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「泡沫頂」出場：euphoria 一上場梗就黏住——極度愉快。

members.senseAnchor: exaggerated feeling of well-being or elation

members.speakLineZh: 請「漂浮感」出場：euphoric 一上場梗就黏住——狂喜的。

members.senseAnchor: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success

related.synonyms: exulting, jubilant, prideful, rejoicing, triumphal, triumphant
